question: Ascent DEF, your team is on eco (~1600cr), ATK on semi-buy (Spectres/Bulldogs). How do you play the defense to maximize round-steal chances?

options.label: Stack 3-4 players on the most likely site at close angles and abandon the other site to play the cheap gunfight
options.explication_courte: On a DEF eco, grouping pistols at close range on one site maximizes the chance of winning the engagement and offsets the weapon gap against SMGs.

options.label: Full 5-stack on one site for maximum firepower, concede the other site entirely
options.explication_courte: A 5-stack squeezes maximum firepower on one site, but hands the opposite site for free and kills all rotation options; slightly less flexible than a 3-4 stack.

sources_option.citation: Maximize eco chances by grouping up and playing close-range together; spreading out loses the weapon-disadvantaged duels.

options.label: Spread 1-1-1-1-1 across both sites and mid like a normal full-buy round
options.explication_courte: A spread defense on eco forces 1v1 pistol-vs-SMG duels at range — duels you lose every time. Eco power comes from grouping, not standard positioning.

sources_option.citation: Eco rounds are won by concentrating firepower at close range; spreading into standard defense positions removes the only advantage a pistol stack has.

options.label: Aggressive 5-man rush toward ATK spawn at round start to catch them off-guard
options.explication_courte: Pushing on eco into a semi-buy opponent in open ground exposes 5 pistols to SMGs at the worst possible range — the very situation you were trying to avoid.

sources_option.citation: Rushing into an enemy team on eco gives away the one advantage you have: the element of surprise at close range on your own ground.

explication_longue:
Situation: Ascent, your team defends on eco (~1600cr, pistols), ATK on semi-buy (Spectres/Bulldogs). Team decision to maximize round-steal chances.

The core DEF eco principle: you can't win range duels against SMGs, so you minimize the number of unfavorable exchanges. The best line is to stack 3-4 players at close angles on the most likely site, cede the other, and set up Trapwires + Spycam for early rotation intel. In a close-range cluster, pistols can trade into Spectres because the TTK gap shrinks at short distance.

A 5-stack on one site (acceptable) also squeezes maximum firepower but gives the opposite site for free. Spreading 1-1-1-1-1 (costly) is the classic eco mistake: every solo duel against SMGs at medium range is losing. Rushing into open ground on eco (mistake) hands the ATK exactly the engagements they want.

Estimated elite distribution: ~52% stack 3-4 on one site, ~22% full 5-stack, ~20% spread (costly), ~4% rush (mistake). GTO tolerance: any grouped line at close range is acceptable; spreading is the only real error.

sources.citation: Maximize eco chances by grouping up and playing close-range together, taking surprise duels or stacking a site to offset the weapon disadvantage.
The standard eco play is to concentrate your pistols at close range on the most likely site; spreading into normal defense positions removes your only advantage.

_gaps.incertitude: Estimations depuis guides d'economie ; la repartition 3-4 stack vs 5-stack depend du score et de la composition precise (agents a util de deny non specifies).
La banque ~1600cr peut varier ; certains joueurs avec un Ghost peuvent jouer des angles plus longs. Le seuil reste sous full-buy.
